name: Tiwanaku

categories.label: Score track (before final offering)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (trước lễ vật cuối)
categories.hint: Read your score marker (starts at 10): includes correct/wrong divinations, Diversity pawn points and offerings made during play.

categories.label: Final offering (different Offering tokens held)
categories.labelVi: Lễ vật cuối (số loại token Offering đang giữ)
categories.hint: After everyone passes, each player may offer: 1 token = 0, 2 = 1, 3 = 3, 4 = 6, 5 = 10 VP.

categories.label: Total spaces advanced on Diversity board
categories.labelVi: Tổng số bước trên bảng Diversity
categories.hint: Tiebreaker only: total spaces moved on all four terrain tracks.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who moved the most total spaces on all Terrain tracks of the Diversity board wins

notes: family: running-track-plus-final-offering. Score marker starts on space 10 and tracks most points during play. Game ends after the last Terrain tile is placed; each player then gets final divinations (correct = level of crop in VP and an Offering token; wrong = lose that many VP), then one final offering. Enter the score track value as read after the final divinations and before the final offering. Variants: tiwanaku--coop (also covers solo vs Otoma).
